**Game & mods has a window of its own; Terrain and Blocks say what they are for**

The version of Minecraft, the mods, the modpack instances and the resource packs whose blocks you paint with are now set up in File ▸ Game & mods…, also opened by a button at the top of the Blocks panel, which keeps only the blocks to paint with and says which game and how many mods it read. The Terrain panel and the Blocks panel each open with a line saying what they are for: Terrain is the map's terrains, Blocks every block of your game and its mods, to paint with. Asked for by Jack (Fornad).
